frozen_rules: Behavior Drift Profile, BDD Statistic, and Representation Evaluation are separate concepts.
Every BDD row explicitly identifies Reference, Target, task, evaluation mode, representation, and null or calibration.
All semantic deltas use Target minus Reference.
The 13-leaf behavior taxonomy is fixed; missing dimensions remain N/A with a reason code.
BDD significance does not determine semantic direction.
Behavior Profile and Representation Scorecard are separate mandatory tables.
Cross-representation raw MMD2 comparison is prohibited.
Existing frozen conclusions are not modified by schema migration.
